topic_theme: World Cup 2026 knockout stage (quarterfinals done, semifinals July 14-15)

incident.summary: First all-in-one POST (1.3 MB, 8 base64 images) returned HTTP 546 WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMIT, but the Edge Function had already inserted the first 5 articles before being killed. The batch retry (2 per request) then re-inserted those 5 with -2 suffixes, creating 5 duplicate rows on the portal.
incident.cleanup_needed: Delete ONE row from each of the 5 duplicated pairs (content is identical). Requires DB/dashboard access; the publish endpoint is insert-only so the agent could not remove them.
incident.future_fix: Always POST in small batches (<=2 articles) from the start; never send all 8 base64 images in one request.
